hero.title: Every Cup, a Moment of Calm
hero.subtitle: Freshly roasted beans, skilled baristas, and a cozy space — Noor Coffee is where your day begins again.

about.title: From Bean to Cup, With Love
about.body: Noor Coffee started in 2019 with a simple dream: a place where people could enjoy a truly great cup of coffee and step away from the noise of the day. Our beans are roasted weekly, and every drink is made with care and patience.
